captions.detailed: A compact camera speedlight flash accessory in matte black. The main body is a stepped rectangular column featuring a thin, flat battery door on one side and a metallic shoe mount at the base. Atop the body sits a cylindrical swivel base that supports a U-shaped aiming neck, which holds a rectangular lamp head. The lamp head rotates on a horizontal tilt axis between the arms of the neck, while the neck itself rotates on a vertical swivel axis relative to the main body.
captions.instruction: Generate a camera speedlight flash accessory as an articulated model. The assembly must include a stepped main body with a side battery door and a bottom hot-shoe mount, a vertical swivel joint supporting a U-shaped neck, and a horizontal tilt joint holding a rectangular flash head.
captions.factory: Construct the speedlight using four main parts. First, build the 'body' by combining a bottom metallic shoe mount plate, a stepped rectangular main block, and a thin side panel representing the battery door. Second, create the 'swivel' component containing a cylindrical swivel base and a U-shaped neck bracket. Third, model the 'head' as a rectangular block representing the flash light source. Finally, define the articulations: a revolute joint for the vertical swivel axis between the body and neck, a revolute joint for the horizontal tilt axis between the neck and head, and a revolute joint for the side-hinged battery door.
